title: Cardinal Billing Account State Amendatory Schedule: State Billing Charge on Additional-Premium Bills
content:
**Schedule clause.** The billing charge on a Cardinal Billing Account additional-premium bill is figured on the state billing charge for the governing state of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy the account bills. The state billing charge is $2.50 when the governing state of the auto policy is Kentucky, $4.00 when that state is Virginia or West Virginia, and the pay plan's installment fee when it is any other state.

The governing state is the state recorded on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy as the garaging state whose law governs the policy.

| Governing state on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy | State billing charge |
|---|---|
| Kentucky (KY) | $2.50 |
| Virginia (VA) | $4.00 |
| West Virginia (WV) | $4.00 |
| Ohio (OH) | The pay plan's installment fee |
| Indiana (IN) | The pay plan's installment fee |

**Notes.** The Kentucky and Virginia or West Virginia figures apply on every pay plan. For Ohio and Indiana policies the state billing charge is the installment fee figure of the account's own pay plan.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a plan with a $5.00 installment fee, a West Virginia policy's state billing charge is $4.00 and an Indiana policy's is $5.00.
